statutes.name: Contract
statutes.definition: A binding agreement between parties that the law will enforce.

statutes.name: Fraud
statutes.definition: Intentional deception to secure unfair or unlawful gain.

statutes.name: Larceny
statutes.definition: The unlawful taking of property belonging to another.

statutes.name: Negligence
statutes.definition: Failure to take the care a reasonable person would take.

statutes.name: Tort
statutes.definition: A civil wrong for which a court may award damages.

statutes.name: Perjury-Oath
statutes.definition: A solemn commitment to tell the truth in court.

statutes.name: Bail
statutes.definition: Money deposited to secure the release of an accused person before trial.

statutes.name: Fine
statutes.definition: Money exacted as punishment for an offence.

statutes.name: Verdict
statutes.definition: The finding of a jury on the issues submitted to it.

statutes.name: Warrant
statutes.definition: A writ from a court authorising an arrest or search.
